structured_output.summary: In GroupedAggregateHashTable::FindOrCreateGroupsInternal (src/execution/aggregate_hashtable.cpp), new groups now go to the unpartitioned staging collection only when the row layout is all fixed-width (layout_ptr->AllConstant()). Otherwise they are appended directly to partitioned_data. This removes the second heap copy and pointer recompute that Abandon/Repartition did for VARCHAR or nested group keys. Release build OK. Two `bench q16` runs: 174.4→163.0 ms (-6.5%), then 173.8→160.4 ms (-7.7%). Both runs checked results.
structured_output.generality: Helps hash aggregates (including DISTINCT aggregates) with variable-size group keys such as VARCHAR or nested types, when they are fed small chunks (for example after selective joins) and the HT has many radix bits. Fixed-width layouts behave exactly as before. Correctness doesn't depend on which collection is used, because both paths already existed and set the same pointers. The spill path was tested earlier with list and long-string keys at a 100MB memory limit.
structured_output.notes: This is the third submission of the same idea. Earlier bench medians were about -4% to -5% and very noisy (range -17% to +2%). This session's two runs were -6.5% and -7.7%. If it is rejected again for noise, stop trying it. Other q16 targets would be per-row main-HT sink cost, distinct finalize, or compacting the join's ~300-row output chunks.
